cases.given: Numbers, citations, and conclusion must remain unchanged while prose changes.
cases.expect: Creates the four-item local checklist, rewrites, verifies each item, promotes no new global state, and retires the checklist. Result: A clearer paragraph with all four invariants intact and no stale scaffold.
cases.reject: Omitting the mechanism or instead doing this: It does not reload the full paper, invent a new outline, or keep the checklist active for later sections.

cases.given: a one-step task has no fragile constraints
cases.expect: Remain inactive; do not begin the package-specific first step: Identify the current subtask and the specific failure risks within it.
cases.reject: Activating Micro-Scaffolding solely because its name appears relevant

cases.given: Global task locks and source boundaries outrank a local scaffold.
cases.expect: Honor the conflict rule and preserve this invariant: Keep the scaffold task-local and smaller than canonical workflow state.
cases.reject: Silently violating the stated precedence for Micro-Scaffolding

cases.given: Escalate when the required control cannot remain local or when the scaffold grows into a duplicate of the parent plan/state.
cases.expect: Stop, narrow, abstain, or escalate while preserving: identify the fragile local invariants
cases.reject: Claiming a successful Micro-Scaffolding result past this boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A localized rewrite with four protected atoms and a larger StateBlock already present.
cases.expect: Create a smaller temporary four-item control, preserve all atoms, then retire it after verification.
cases.reject: Copy the whole StateBlock, omit local checkpoints, or carry the scaffold into unrelated work.
